annotation.title_clean: 国家文物局办公室关于开展2022年“高层次文博行业人才提升计划”的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the National Cultural Heritage Administration on Carrying Out the 2022 "High-level Cultural Heritage and Museum Talent Enhancement Plan"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家文物局办公室 (National Cultural Heritage Administration, General Office)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Cultural Heritage Administration notice announcing the 2022 enrolment of in-service cultural heritage and museum staff in master's programmes at Northwest University, Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture, and Yunnan University. It covers eligibility, curriculum, application process and fees. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Master's programmes for in-service heritage staff via national entrance exam, with at least one year of full-time study
Three host universities with dual-supervisor system
Application deadlines: exam registration by Oct 31, plan registration by Nov 15
Annual tuition ranges from 8,000 to 14,000 yuan, charged by universities
Local liaison officers conduct initial review by Nov 30
